aiSubtitle: Ask a question about Mozambican tax
faq1Q: What is the legal deadline for filing and paying the periodic VAT return (Model A)?
faq1A: Under the Mozambican VAT Code (Law No. 32/2007, as amended), the periodic return and the corresponding payment must be made by the last business day of the month following the period to which the transactions relate.
faq2Q: How does IRPC withholding tax work for services provided by non-residents?
faq2A: A 20% final rate applies (Art. 66 of the CIRPC), calculated on the taxable base grossed up by the counter-value factor (1.25), unless a ratified Double Taxation Agreement (DTA) provides a reduced rate (e.g. 10% with Portugal or South Africa) upon presentation of a Tax Residency Certificate.
faq3Q: By what day must payroll be submitted and INSS contributions paid?
faq3A: Payroll sheets must be uploaded and the corresponding amount (3% employee + 4% employer) settled by the 10th day of the month following the month they relate to.
faq4Q: What happens if a company pays tax after the legal deadline?
faq4A: Under Article 101 of the General Tax Law (Law No. 2/2006), late payment subjects the taxpayer to a fine of 25% to 100% of the tax due, plus late-payment interest calculated at the Bank of Mozambique reference rate (MIMO) plus 2 percentage points.
